name: Auto Input
description: Detects the level hitboxes and the player hitbox and automatically clicks, holds or spam-clicks to dodge obstacles.

enabled.name: Enable Auto Input
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the mod never touches your inputs.

mode.name: Detection mode
mode.description: <cg>Performance</c>: only reads the hitboxes near the player (lighter). <cy>Full level</c>: caches every hitbox of the level when it starts (more memory and a longer load, but very light per frame).

detect.name: What to detect
detect.description: <cg>Spikes & blocks</c>: only hazards and solid blocks. <cy>Everything</c>: also slopes and breakable blocks.

detect-range.name: Detection range (units)
detect-range.description: How far ahead of the player hitboxes are read. 30 units = 1 block.

auto-trigger.name: Automatic reaction distance
auto-trigger.description: The reaction distance is computed from the player's speed and game mode. Turn off to use the manual value below.

trigger-distance.name: Reaction distance (units)
trigger-distance.description: How close to an obstacle the player must be before reacting. Only used when the automatic distance is off.

reaction-ms.name: Reaction time (ms)
reaction-ms.description: Delay between detecting an obstacle and acting on it, from 0 ms to 1 second.

margin.name: Safety margin (units)
margin.description: Extra clearance added around every hitbox when planning.

no-record.name: Don't save completions
no-record.description: If Auto Input clicked during an attempt, the completion is NOT saved (treated like a test run). Keeps leaderboards and your stats legit.
